scope: Jielan composition refinement: open asymmetric linen folds, fewer floating scraps, a continuous green and cobalt diagonal, smaller matte seeds and seven layered flower heads in the transparent parcel. Cutlery and material seams have independent depth. The visible equal-axis body retains round shoulders and belly. All other five artwork pages, runtimes and asset bundles retain exact source bytes, including Still Falling 0.31.0.
fallingInteraction: Explicit 3D entry, orbit and zoom, keyboard rotation, independent front/side/back views and three closeups, material separation, restrained fragment movement, neutral/cool light, structural inspection, complete reset and view capture. The original canvas moves into the immersive dialog; offscreen and hidden-document rendering pauses.
jielanInteraction: Real orbit, zoom and independent front/side/back cameras; one-click reset clears rotation, material separation, study light and closeups. Camera-space bounds fitting preserves relative zoom on resize. Resource disposal and WebGL restoration are handled in the viewer.
interaction: Six-work native navigation, optional session-only resume, desktop chapters and directory, mobile bottom actions, high-resolution image viewer with filmstrip and zoom, native dialog focus and Back-to-close.
mobilePresentation: All devices first display the complete high-resolution artwork. Visitors explicitly start 3D; view=live and build=1 preserve direct live access. Page scrolling stays native, with pinch and pan restricted to the viewing surface. No automatic tour, audio, account or analytics.
images: Jielan has same-scene cover, three independent closeups, side/back views, poster and GLB with a build manifest. Other artwork bundles retain their bytes and scene editions. No complete source-reference image is used as the new artwork or projected over a sphere.
modelLimitations: GLB files contain static geometry/material snapshots, not webpage lighting, motion, interaction or audio. Rendering uses original procedural material studies; it does not claim scanned materials or photographic reconstruction.
referenceUse: The user-provided green/cobalt collage and Jielan lyrics inform material relationships and composition. No complete reference image, artist names, logos, full lyrics or font files are published. Existing macro material atlases, licensed icons and local Three.js 0.180.0 retain their recorded provenance.
